question: What is the meaning of building physics in relation to physical properties, technical properties?
description: Building physics in relation to physical properties and technical properties refers to the study and understanding of how buildings interact with their environment in terms of energy efficiency, thermal performance, heat transfer, and other related aspects. It involves analyzing the physical characteristics of buildings and materials to optimize their performance and sustainability.
